ArchiveVersionInput.description: Represents the input for archiving a version.

archiveName.description: The name of the archive. The default value is 'archive'.

itemId.description: The ID of the item to archive. If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.

itemPath.description: The full path of the item to archive. If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.

language.description: The language of the version to archive.

version.description: The version number to archive. If not present, the latest version will be used.
